A [[human]] '''employee''' of the [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] that worked at it's [[Imperial Bureau of Standards Coruscant office|Headquarters]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> in [[4 BBY]].<ref name="Date202">{{AndorDate|202}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The new Bureau of Standards employee was portrayed by [[Aron Dochard]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Sagrona Teema]]," the second episode of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]],<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character is identified as "New Employee" in the credits.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />
